info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Payments Payments Capture-v2-spec
info.description: The Payment Capture API enables businesses to efficiently capture payment transactions in bulk. This API is designed for developers who need to integrate payment processing capabilities into their applications, facilitating seamless payment handling. It supports various use cases, such as processing multiple payment captures simultaneously, which enhances transaction efficiency and reduces time spent on manual payment reconciliations. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms, financial institutions, and service providers who focus on optimizing their payment workflows.

post.description: This operation captures a payment that has been previously authorized. It is used to finalize the payment process and ensure that the funds are transferred from the customer's account to the merchant's account.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to capture a payment that has been previously authorized. Ensure that the payment details are accurate and conform to the required schema to successfully process the capture.
